files.evidence: Read in full (97 lines). It uses a fixed run-state.json suffix below host workspaceDir (32-40), hashes content with SHA-256 (71-96), and stores agent/workspace only as JSON keys, not path segments (28-29). Read-modify-rename can lose concurrent updates because it does not use the shared atomicJsonUpdate mutex (39-55), and checkMaxPromotions counts lifetime IDs despite its per-run name (64-68); these are functional/concurrency defects, not an attacker-reachable privileged sink in this module.

Read in full (203 lines). runSkillMiner writes every accepted LLM proposal at lines 124-169 even when opts.dryRun is true; dryRun gates only the report and rate-state writes at 183-197. Agent is interpolated into the lock filename without safeAgentId/resolveInside at 76-88. Trusted stored evidence becomes LLM-generated instructions in a pending proposal (29-50, 124-159); supporting command review omits instructions (lib/telegram-commands/skill-commands.js:24-49) while approval writes them as SKILL.md (52-71), retaining a model-to-executable-instructions candidate.

Read in full (112 lines). It performs deterministic in-memory token clustering and scoring only. The all-pairs algorithm at lines 48-59 is quadratic over up to 5,000 rows from the caller and is a performance/availability bug candidate, but input must already pass trusted-evidence filters and there is no independent privileged sink here.

Read in full (98 lines). Memory text is marked untrusted in the prompt (13-34), output uses JSON mode, a token cap, confidence gate, and required-field check (53-93), but instructions and examples have no structural/content constraints and are forwarded verbatim. The timeout race does not cancel the underlying LLM call (54-64), a cost/reliability issue. Candidate severity depends on the later user-review/approval boundary, which does not show the instructions by default.

Read in full (30 lines). It renders a proposal description/title through the localization layer; it has no file, process, query, or automatic activation sink. Presentation injection is bounded by downstream chat handling and does not itself approve a proposal.

rawCandidates.title: Skill-miner dry-run still persists LLM-generated proposals
rawCandidates.source: An operator/caller invokes runSkillMiner with opts.dryRun=true and qualifying evidence exists.
rawCandidates.control: dryRun gates only report append and recordJobRun; it is not checked before writeProposal.
rawCandidates.sink: writeProposal appends the LLM candidate to .adaptive-learning/skill-proposals.jsonl.
rawCandidates.impact: A purported non-mutating run changes the executable-skill review queue and permanently blocks same-name proposals through deduplication.
rawCandidates.validationFacts: Control-flow mismatch is confirmed. Validate with a stub extractor/write target and establish which production or administrative callers expose dryRun.
rawCandidates.attackFacts: Requires an authorized/internal caller plus qualifying evidence and LLM output; no remote unauthenticated trigger is established.

rawCandidates.title: Skill-miner lock path interpolates an unvalidated agent identifier
rawCandidates.source: Host command context agentId is passed into runSkillMiner.
rawCandidates.control: No safeAgentId or resolveInside call precedes the lock path join.
rawCandidates.sink: acquireJobLock creates and releaseJobLock removes skill-miner-${agent}.lock.
rawCandidates.impact: A separator-bearing agent ID may create/remove a fixed-suffix file outside the intended locks directory.
rawCandidates.validationFacts: Unsafe construction is confirmed; establish exact caller source and OpenClaw agent-ID canonicalization.
rawCandidates.attackFacts: Requires control of host agentId, not skill-miner evidence or ordinary command arguments alone.

rawCandidates.title: Skill approval can activate LLM-generated instructions that the default review omits
rawCandidates.source: Stored memory excerpts are supplied to an LLM that returns arbitrary instructions.
rawCandidates.control: Evidence trust/confidence gates and explicit authorized approval exist, but the default pending-proposal review shows only title, score, confidence, and an 80-character description; approval is bound only to an ID, not an exact displayed content hash.
rawCandidates.sink: approveProposal renders the unshown instructions verbatim into workspace skills/<safeSlug>/SKILL.md, which is executable agent configuration on later skill loading.
rawCandidates.impact: Prompt-injected or compromised-model instructions can be approved under an innocuous summary and later steer tool use/data access with the user's skill authority.
rawCandidates.validationFacts: Code-level review/approval mismatch is complete. Validate router authorization, exact chat UX, proposal tamper window, skill auto-discovery semantics, and whether /skills show is mandatory or merely optional.
rawCandidates.attackFacts: Requires influence over qualifying trusted evidence or the configured LLM plus convincing an authorized user to approve by ID. safeSlug prevents path traversal but not malicious instruction content.

notes: Three candidates retained. Feature-preserving remedies are genuine no-write dry-run, agent validation, and exact full-content/hash-bound approval—not disabling skill mining.
